additional_context: FHIR-37841 later clarified MetadataResource.topic keyword wording and has already been reconciled separately on the combined branch. FHIR-38841 later deprecated MetadataResource.topic in favor of useContext topic codes, so current topic comments correctly retain migration guidance. The artifact-topic extension is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than core.
